annotations.title: SEC ROIC - return on invested capital

description: SEC ROIC - return on invested capital — Return on invested capital for any US-listed company from SEC XBRL 10-K facts (5 fiscal years): NOPAT (operating income x (1 - effective tax rate)), invested capital (equity + debt - cash), ROIC on average capital, ROE, ROA, incremental ROIC, trend, verdict ELITE/STRONG/ADEQUATE/WEAK/NEGATIVE and a cost-of-capital comparison, with flags (negative equity, pretax proxy for banks). Params: ticker= (or cik=). Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_roic
